title: AI Concepts Hierarchy
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Prompt Engineering
description: A nested infographic of the twenty foundational AI concepts, from Artificial Intelligence at the outside down to Human-AI Interaction at the centre, with hover definitions and click-to-highlight dependencies.

learningObjectives: Classify the foundational AI concepts into their hierarchical relationships
Explain how each concept builds on the concepts that contain it

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Nested containment diagram with hover definitions and dependency highlighting
keyQuestions: Why is Human-AI Interaction the most deeply nested concept?
What would stop working if training data disappeared?
commonMisconceptions: Thinking a transformer is a category that contains neural networks rather than a kind of neural network
Treating Generative AI as separate from Large Language Models
assessmentOpportunities: Place a newly encountered term in the correct container
Explain why Context Window depends on Token
